title: 48th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/48/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the matter of removing the Vice President and a member of the Anti-Corruption Commission from office is sent to the relevant standing committee under Rule 232(b) of the Standing Orders.
From the Speaker's desk: the matter of removing the President of the Civil Service Commission from office is sent to the relevant standing committee under Rule 232(b) of the Standing Orders.

From the Speaker's desk: the matter of removing the Vice President and two members of the Elections Commission from office is sent to the relevant standing committee under Rule 232(b) of the Standing Orders.
First reading of the resolution submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim calling on the government to push for speedy passage of the bill banning entry into the Maldives on Israeli passports.
Debate on the proposed State Budget for 2025, under Article 96(a) of the Constitution.
Social Affairs Committee report on its review of the Bill amending the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent moves to remove members of the Anti-Corruption, Civil Service and Elections commissions to committee, introduced a resolution on banning Israeli passport holders, debated the 2025 State Budget and took up a Tobacco Control Act report.
